title: Grade 4 CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — General Assessment #2

pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What did Jesus tell the ten men to do? (1 mark)
   A. Pay money
   B. Go home
   C. Go and show themselves to the priests
   D. Wash in the river

2. Which is a personal item? (1 mark)
   A. The school gate
   B. A school uniform
   C. A library book
   D. A classroom desk

3. What happened after Jesus spoke? (1 mark)
   A. He ran away
   B. The crowd left
   C. Nothing
   D. The dead man sat up and began to talk

4. What does the big tree stand for? (1 mark)
   A. The growth of God's kingdom
   B. A palace
   C. A mountain
   D. A market

5. Where did Abram live before going to Canaan? (1 mark)
   A. Bethlehem
   B. Egypt
   C. Haran
   D. Rome

6. What should you do if something online frightens you? (1 mark)
   A. Share it
   B. Close it and tell a trusted adult
   C. Keep it secret
   D. Keep looking

7. What is one warning sign that a situation is unsafe? (1 mark)
   A. You feel happy
   B. You feel proud
   C. You feel uneasy or scared
   D. You feel sleepy

8. What gave Samson the strength to kill the lion? (1 mark)
   A. The Spirit of the Lord
   B. His long hair alone
   C. His parents
   D. Special food

9. Which verse says that there is no one holy like the Lord? (1 mark)
   A. Isaiah 49:16
   B. Luke 1:37
   C. 1 Samuel 2:2
   D. Galatians 5:22

10. Abram travelled from Haran to Canaan, which lies to the south-west of Haran. In which direction did he travel? (1 mark)
   A. East
   B. North-east
   C. North
   D. South-west

11. What does obedience mean? (1 mark)
   A. Doing what you like
   B. Doing what those in authority say when it is good and right
   C. Arguing
   D. Refusing rules

12. Which of these is the first book of the New Testament? (1 mark)
   A. Romans
   B. Acts
   C. Matthew
   D. Genesis

13. According to the Lord's Prayer, we ask God to forgive us as we: (1 mark)
   A. Forgive others
   B. Forget others
   C. Punish others
   D. Ignore others

14. Which of these is a physical need? (1 mark)
   A. A toy
   B. A loud radio
   C. Food
   D. A game

15. Which of these can harm the body? (1 mark)
   A. Fruit
   B. Rest
   C. Clean water
   D. Drugs

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. State three lessons that we learn from the story of Joseph interpreting the dream. (3 marks)

17. Explain four ways of building self-control. (4 marks)

18. Explain how repentance draws a person close to Christ and how a child can repent. (5 marks)

19. Explain why Zechariah was unable to speak. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Go and show themselves to the priests
   Luke 17:14 records this instruction.

2. B — A school uniform
   Personal items belong to you.

3. D — The dead man sat up and began to talk
   Luke 7:15 says he sat up and began to talk.

4. A — The growth of God's kingdom
   The kingdom grows large.

5. C — Haran
   Terah's family settled in Haran.

6. B — Close it and tell a trusted adult
   Tell someone who can help.

7. C — You feel uneasy or scared
   Uneasy feelings are a signal to move away.

8. A — The Spirit of the Lord
   The Spirit of the Lord came powerfully upon him.

9. C — 1 Samuel 2:2
   1 Samuel 2:2 declares God's holiness.

10. D — South-west
   Canaan is south-west of Haran, so he travelled south-west.

11. B — Doing what those in authority say when it is good and right
   Obedience means following good instructions.

12. C — Matthew
   Matthew is the first of the four Gospels and of the New Testament.

13. A — Forgive others
   The prayer links our forgiveness with forgiving others.

14. C — Food
   Food, water, clothing and shelter are physical needs.

15. D — Drugs
   Drugs harm the body and mind.

SECTION B
----
16. (3 marks)
   Answer: Depend on God; do not give up when life is unfair; use gifts to serve others; save for hard times.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

17. (4 marks)
   Answer: Pray each morning, set small goals, keep busy with good activities, choose good friends, avoid tempting situations.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each way up to 4.

18. (5 marks)
   Answer: Sin separates us from God. When we are sorry and turn from wrong, God forgives and we draw near to Him. A child can admit wrong, say sorry to God and others, put things right, and decide to do better with the Spirit's help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for sin separating, 1 for forgiveness, 1 for admitting, 1 for putting right, 1 for deciding to do better.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: He doubted the angel's message. The angel said that he would be silent until the baby was born because he did not believe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for doubt, 1 for the angel's words, 1 for silence until it happened.
